## Issues

<!--
Put a closing keyword directly before the number of each issue this finishes:
close, closes, closed, fix, fixes, fixed, resolve, resolves, resolved.

  Closes #NNN, closes #MMM    each number needs its own keyword
  Closes #NNN #MMM            closes the first one only
  Refs #NNN                   links without closing, for partial work

The keyword also reaches a number further along the sentence, and quoting does
not exempt it. "Closes the send-time half of #NNN" closes that issue, and so
does the same string inside a fenced code block. Two issues here were closed
that way by pull requests that said in their next sentence they were not
closing them.

So: no issue number in this body unless you mean it, including in quoted text.
-->
